ohlcv.selection: highest total volume from the strictly prior completed Globex session

development.purpose: Primitive, episode and playbook-definition development; no PnL-driven threshold search.

calibration.purpose: Fit the frozen typed Brain reliability mappings from causal 2022 rows only.

brain_validation.purpose: Validate the frozen 2022 Brain mappings across time, direction and regime; no refit or mapping revision.

brain_calibration_trial.purpose: Fixed diagnostic calibration-row trial for recorder, schema, deadline, uncertainty, obstruction and funnel checks; forbidden from artifact fitting.

rolling_oof.purpose: One rolling out-of-fold evaluation after the vertical chain is stable.

sealed_holdout.purpose: Single final reveal after code, registry, calibration and execution bindings are frozen.

development.purpose: Observed spread, depth, fillability and cost development only.

sealed_holdout.purpose: Single final execution-reality reveal; DBN content remains sealed until authorized.

natural_authority_2023.purpose: Outcome-blind Group1-5 natural-authority lifecycle and continuous Scene Graph review; no PnL or threshold selection.
natural_authority_2023.selection_rule: From 2023 Globex weeks whose review week and preceding local-calendar warmup week each contain exactly 6900 causal rows under one unchanged contract, sample with Python random seed 20230807 until the review weeks are at least 90 days apart.
natural_authority_2023.maximum_extension: 2023 calendar year; zero natural cases remain authority_pending

mature_range_coverage.purpose: Outcome-blind descriptive coverage of natural H1 dealing ranges and range-boundary manipulation.

mature_range_development_junes.purpose: Outcome-blind Group4 range and all-scale manipulation coverage on the five registered development windows.

group4_natural_authority_2023_full_year.purpose: Registered outcome-blind 2023 Group4 natural-authority upper-bound scan; calibration-period prices may be used only for primitive lifecycle coverage.

eye_group1_5_natural_authority_2023_full.purpose: Registered outcome-blind 2023 full-eye natural-authority scan for Group1-5 plus Displacement; calibration-period prices are used only for primitive identity, lifecycle, ordering and transport coverage.

mature_range_target.meaning: rare high-quality persistent H1 balance or accumulation, not a generic H1 dealing range
systematic_miss_requires: no sustained one-way delivery dominates the interval
the balance persists for multiple completed H1 bars
different-month cases are repeatedly rejected for the same gate or source-identity reason

stopping_rules: isolated anomalies do not change a definition
one repeated semantic miss across different months permits at most one conceptual repair
a repair is checked on a different frozen window rather than retuning 2023
a sparse but visually accurate MatureBalanceRange remains a rare context
an unstable MatureBalanceRange remains parked and FAVR may only become an optional LSR range context

brain_episode_sequence_census_2022_01_18.mechanism_challenges: neutral Eye candidates are reported separately and never enter playbook acceptance rates

leakage_rules: Only completed bars at or before the decision clock may enter Observation, Scene Graph, Belief, Decision or Risk.
MBO supplies execution reality only; it cannot define SMC primitives, market labels or future direction.
Calibration, rolling OOF, MBO stability and sealed holdout are separate stages and cannot select each other's thresholds.
The sealed OHLCV and MBO windows cannot be opened to repair a failed development hypothesis.
Same-bar stop and target ambiguity is resolved conservatively.
